Description: Bank hold controller drives aileron from phi_cmd - phi error
Bank error computed as phi_cmd minus phi
Pitch hold controller drives elevator from theta_cmd - theta error
Pitch error computed as theta_cmd minus theta
Airspeed hold controller drives throttle from V_cmd - V error
Airspeed error computed as V_cmd minus V
Throttle saturated to the range 0 to 1
Root inport phi_cmd accepts commanded bank in radians
Root inport theta_cmd accepts commanded pitch in radians
Root inport V_cmd accepts commanded airspeed in m/s
Root outport delta_a_out exposes aileron command in radians
Root outport delta_e_out exposes elevator command in radians
Root outport delta_t_out exposes throttle command 0..1
